text:
alex: Hey team — assembling a compact multi-cloud provisioning mini-playbook for new orgs. Focus: IAM, billing, tags, GPU quotas (AWS/GCP/Azure), networking limits, and quick links/templates. Posting draft below, plz eyeball for missing bits.

priya: Nice. Can we include a cost-center tagging pattern and the required labels for billing exports?

matt: Also add which GPU families we request by default (A100 vs H100 vs V100) and an escalation path if quotas are denied.

olivia: Draft checklist incoming. I kept items short so it's easy to run through during onboarding calls.

olivia: CHECKLIST — high level walk-through (one-liner each):
- Create org/account/project and enable billing export to a central bucket.
- Create infra service account(s) + upload public keys to vault.
- IAM: attach least-privilege roles; add infra-admin group with just-in-time escalation for 24h.
- Tags/labels: add cost_center, rdw_env, team_owner, project_code.
- Request GPU & vCPU quotas in target regions: include exact instance families + per-region counts.
- Networking: raise ENI/NAT/GW limits, reserve static IPs, and request increased GCP external IP quota if needed.
- Set up monitoring/alerts for quota usage and pre-warn at 70% utilization.
- Document default fallback models (lower-GPU family or CPU-only) + routing policy.

sam: For tags, our canonical example: cost_center=rdw-inference, rdw_env=prod, team_owner=ml-platform, project_code=customer-onboard-123

priya: Adding billing export note: for GCP, enable Billing export to BigQuery and also daily CSV to GCS for our cost pipeline. For AWS, enable Cost and Usage Report to S3 with hourly granularity.

matt: GPU quota request template (paste into support ticket):
```
Hello, we'd like to request a quota increase for GPUs in region us-west-2.
Account: 123456789012
Requested instances: p4d.24xlarge (H100) — new limit 16 instances, p3.8xlarge (A100) — new limit 32 instances.
Use case: production inference for Redwood Inference — steady-state, low-latency serving.
Estimated sustained utilization: 60% for p4d, 40% for p3.
Please advise expected lead time and any additional verification needed.
```

olivia: GCP quota request tip: include project number, region, and quota metric names (e.g., "TPU v2/TPU v3 quota" or "GPUs (NVIDIA A100) per region"). Example sentence: "Project: 987654321, request increase of GPUs (A100) to 24 in us-central1 for latency-critical inference; estimated monthly vCPU and GPU hours attached."

sam: Networking items to request up-front: increase Nat Gateways, EIP quota, ENI quota, LB target limit, and a higher VPC peering quota if cross-account peering planned. For GCP, bump routes and reserved IP quota.

alex: Add escalation path: if quota denied >48h, open urgent support ticket + DM sales-eng for account-level contact, then spin up dedicated capacity in secondary region with HPA-friendly fallback.

olivia: Automation snippets: service account + key (minimal example)
```bash
# GCP: create SA + grant roles
gcloud iam service-accounts create redwood-infra --display-name="Redwood Infra SA"
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding PROJECT_ID --member="serviceAccount:redwood-infra@PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com" --role="roles/compute.admin"
# store key in vault after creating
```

matt: Also include a checklist item for security: ensure KMS integration for any customer keys and HSM/KMS rotation policy noted.

priya: For Azure, quota requests often need subscription-level support tickets. Default ask: NVv4 family counts per region + network security group limits.

infra-bot: Reminder: attach the onboarding runbook link and the quota request template to the customer's onboarding ticket (#TICKET-XXXXX).

alex: OK — I'll fold these into a short runbook and add to the onboarding template in Notion. Final ask: anybody want to add region-specific gotchas?

sam: One gotcha — some cloud partners block H100 on new accounts; we should ask for A100 as fallback in the initial request.

olivia: Agree. I'll add a short 'fallback model routing' snippet and an ops play for rolling to smaller instance types if quota ramp is slower than expected.

alex: Thanks all — will publish a 1-page cheat-sheet and link it in the onboarding checklist. :thumbsup:
